listing.name: Soulcalibur III — Soulcalibur III Recomp (Arzaroth)
listing.summary: This work in progress is reported to reach menus, character selection and fights with voices and music at one-third speed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own NTSC-U SLUS21216 disc.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Recompile and build locally from your own USA disc using sc3.toml and the project’s function maps. These instructions do not establish an available player package.

warnings: This work in progress is reported to reach menus, character selection and fights with voices and music at one-third speed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
